title: Malicious code in sinhala-cricket-newsjs (npm)
description: The npm package 'sinhala-cricket-newsjs' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different, secure machine. Removing the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious software or control established by the attacker.
